notes.title: Minor updates
notes.notes:
Originally all the suicide options were just labeled as "Kill Self". I changed them to be metaphorical phrases for killing yourself. But, from watching lets plays I didn't like how people got frustrated from not realizing they are about to kill themselves. So I'm adding "(Die)" to all of them so its no longer a frustrating surprise. It is crucial to the message that you are deliberately killing yourself in fear of confronting the scary monster.

Secondly some people didn't realize you can click on buttons sometimes so I'm added a simply hand cursor and made the "return" buttons from clicking a note and the "Live A Different Life" button more obviously clickable.

I wish I did this ages ago but life got in the way. Thank you for playing, I hope you learned something about yourself!
